DNDWIZARD-SPELL_SLOTS_POWER.title: Spell Slots
DNDWIZARD-SPELL_SLOTS_POWER.description: Currently {Amount}/{Capacity}. Choose base casting or Upcast (3 tiers, 4 at spellbook level 4). Once per combat, missing slots can be paid with HP. Slots persist across combats and refill when you choose Rest. Base capacity 6; relics can increase it.
DNDWIZARD-SPELL_SLOTS_POWER.smartDescrip: Currently {Amount}/{Capacity}. Choose base casting or Upcast (3 tiers, 4 at spellbook level 4). Once per combat, missing slots can be paid with HP. Slots persist across combats and refill when you choose Rest. Base capacity 6; relics can increase it.
DNDWIZARD-ARCANE_WARD_POWER.title: Concentration: Arcane Ward
DNDWIZARD-ARCANE_WARD_POWER.description: Gain {Amount} Block whenever you Upcast. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-ARCANE_WARD_POWER.smartDescrip: Gain {Amount} Block whenever you Upcast. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-EVOCATION_POWER.title: Concentration: Evocation
DNDWIZARD-EVOCATION_POWER.description: Wizard attacks deal {Amount} extra damage per hit. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-EVOCATION_POWER.smartDescripti: Wizard attacks deal {Amount} extra damage per hit. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-MEDITATION_POWER.title: Concentration: Meditation
DNDWIZARD-MEDITATION_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, recover {Amount} Spell Slots, up to your capacity. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-MEDITATION_POWER.smartDescript: At the start of your turn, recover {Amount} Spell Slots, up to your capacity. Replaced by another Concentration spell.
DNDWIZARD-DELAYED_RECOVERY_POWER.title: Delayed Recovery
DNDWIZARD-DELAYED_RECOVERY_POWER.descrip: At the start of your next turn, recover {Amount} Spell Slots, then remove this effect. Expires when combat ends.
DNDWIZARD-DELAYED_RECOVERY_POWER.smartDe: At the start of your next turn, recover {Amount} Spell Slots, then remove this effect. Expires when combat ends.
DNDWIZARD-OVERCAST_SPENT_POWER.title: Overcast Spent
DNDWIZARD-OVERCAST_SPENT_POWER.descripti: Overcast has been used this combat. You cannot pay missing slots with HP again until next combat. Normal Upcast remains available.
DNDWIZARD-OVERCAST_SPENT_POWER.smartDesc: Overcast has been used this combat. You cannot pay missing slots with HP again until next combat. Normal Upcast remains available.
DNDWIZARD-FOCUS_SPENT_POWER.title: Focus Spent
DNDWIZARD-FOCUS_SPENT_POWER.description: Your first-Upcast discount has been used this combat. Available again next combat.
DNDWIZARD-FOCUS_SPENT_POWER.smartDescrip: Your first-Upcast discount has been used this combat. Available again next combat.
DNDWIZARD-EMPOWER_POWER.title: Empower
DNDWIZARD-EMPOWER_POWER.description: Your next Upcast attack deals {Amount} additional damage per hit, then consumes all Empower. Other cards do not consume it.
DNDWIZARD-EMPOWER_POWER.smartDescription: Your next Upcast attack deals {Amount} additional damage per hit, then consumes all Empower. Other cards do not consume it.
DNDWIZARD-MIRROR_IMAGE_POWER.title: Mirror Images
DNDWIZARD-MIRROR_IMAGE_POWER.description: When an attack would deal unblocked damage, consume 1 stack to reduce HP lost by 4. Fully blocked attacks and non-attack HP loss do not consume it.
DNDWIZARD-MIRROR_IMAGE_POWER.smartDescri: When an attack would deal unblocked damage, consume 1 stack to reduce HP lost by 4. Fully blocked attacks and non-attack HP loss do not consume it.
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_PROGRESS_POWER.title: Cantrip Study
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_PROGRESS_POWER.descrip: Traveling Spellbook: every two Cantrips recover 1 Spell Slot, at most once per turn. Incomplete progress persists across turns; current progress {Amount}/2.
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_PROGRESS_POWER.smartDe: Traveling Spellbook: every two Cantrips recover 1 Spell Slot, at most once per turn. Incomplete progress persists across turns; current progress {Amount}/2.
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_SPENT_POWER.title: Study Complete
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_SPENT_POWER.descriptio: Cantrip recovery has triggered this turn. It becomes available again next turn.
DNDWIZARD-CANTRIP_SPENT_POWER.smartDescr: Cantrip recovery has triggered this turn. It becomes available again next turn.
